title: TRW and Skunk Works crates in Close Encounters
summary: Jesse Michels tells of TRW and Skunk Works crates in Close Encounters, about 1977 at Close Encounters of the Third Kind, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Close Encounters of the Third Kind

tellings.quote: one piece of that movie outside of there being crates that say TRW and Skunk Works that I think are pretty pretty fascinating

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points out that in Close Encounters of the Third Kind, Steven Spielberg's 1977 film about humans meeting aliens, some crates are marked TRW and Skunk Works. TRW was a defence company, and Skunk Works is Lockheed's secret aircraft design unit. Michels finds this fascinating because it hints that the film may have been nodding at real secret UFO work by those firms.
